hints.title: Span of Influence
hints.text: Determine the span of influence where each element remains the strict maximum or minimum across contiguous neighboring elements.

hints.title: Length Constraint Clamping
hints.text: Constrain the valid subarray spans using the length limit k.

hints.title: Inclusion-Exclusion Combinations
hints.text: Count combinations where the element sits inside intervals of length at most k and multiply by the element value.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Calculates boundary extensions using monotonic stacks in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all subarrays up to size k requires quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Monotonic stack arrays use linear auxiliary storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies monotonic stack with inclusion-exclusion boundary clipping for window length k.
